required_density.format_checker: explicit RFC 3339 date-time checker; negative controls rejected

date_time_validation_correction: The default jsonschema FormatChecker in the validating interpreter does not enforce date-time, so earlier ledger claims of date-time validation did not check it. The explicit RFC 3339 checker finds 0 errors in this report and in the 2026-10-20 density reports cited before this pass.

tool_call_time_limits.problem: On the Jido 2.4 stack, agent-started tool calls used Jido.AI's fixed 15,000 ms per-tool deadline instead of tool_timeout_ms. On both stacks an approval or question wait counted against the tool deadline, so the wait was killed and recorded uncertain long before question_timeout_ms.

reproduction_before_fix.probe: agent-started Question tool through the public API with a delayed answer
reproduction_before_fix.failure: killed at tool_timeout_ms; question_timeout_ms was unreachable

contract: With a session coordinator, an agent-started or direct tool call may run for tool_timeout_ms plus question_timeout_ms; a standalone context uses tool_timeout_ms.
Commands still stop at tool_timeout_ms, answers at question_timeout_ms and runs at run_timeout_ms.
A question whose waiting call ends is withdrawn: :approval_answered reports {:error, :withdrawn} and a later answer returns {:error, :unknown_question}.
Cancellation, run completion and stop_session/1 close pending questions without an :approval_answered event.

cases.name: an agent-started call ends at the runtime's tool and question limits
cases.before_fix: passed: this SDK already honored tool_timeout_ms for agent calls

cases.name: an agent-started question may wait longer than the tool budget
cases.before_fix: failed: the question was killed at the 300 ms tool budget and the answer returned {:error, :unknown_question}

cases.name: a direct call may wait for approval longer than the tool budget
cases.before_fix: failed: the approval wait was killed at the 1,000 ms tool limit

cases.name: a question is withdrawn when its waiting call ends
cases.before_fix: failed: no :approval_answered withdrawal event within 5,000 ms
